name: vnc_screenshot
description: Capture a screenshot of the remote desktop. Returns a JPEG image encoded as base64. Use this to see what is currently displayed on the screen. Do NOT rely solely on screenshots for click targeting — use vnc_window_list or vnc_active_window for authoritative window positions, and vnc_ocr_region to verify text content.

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID to capture from. If omitted, uses the default endpoint.

delay.description: Milliseconds to wait before capturing, allowing the screen to settle after prior actions. Default: 0.

name: vnc_capture_burst
description: Capture a rapid sequence of frames in ONE call to observe transient UI states (toast popups, hover highlights, animations, progress indicators) whose lifetime is shorter than a manual screenshot round trip. Returns one image per frame plus per-frame timestamps in ms from burst start. Internally sends one full-frame baseline then incremental updates only, so mostly-static screens cost little per frame. Use a small region for tight verification targets and lower quality/scale for long bursts.

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID to capture from. If omitted, uses the default endpoint.

count.description: Number of frames to capture (clamped 1-30). Default: 15.

quality.description: JPEG quality 1-100. Default: 60; automatically reduced if the response payload cap is exceeded.

scale.description: Uniform downscale factor applied to each frame after cropping (clamped 0.05-4.0). Default: 0.5.

region_x.description: Optional capture region: left edge in framebuffer pixels. All four region_* values must be given to crop.

region_y.description: Optional capture region: top edge in framebuffer pixels.

region_w.description: Optional capture region: width in framebuffer pixels.

region_h.description: Optional capture region: height in framebuffer pixels.

name: vnc_probe
description: Place a yellow marker at specific coordinates on a screenshot WITHOUT clicking or interacting with the remote desktop. The marker is drawn server-side on the image only — no mouse movement, no focus change, no menus closed. Use this to visually verify computed coordinates before committing to a click. Returns the annotated screenshot with a coordinate label, guide box lines offset by 30px, and axis labels at screen edges for precise spatial reference. The solid magenta dot at the center marks the exact click target point.

coordinate_source_resolution.description: The Resolution value from the vnc_screenshot or vnc_grid response you used to estimate these coordinates, in WxH format (e.g. "1918x968"). Copy this directly from the tool response text.

coordinate_space.description: 'framebuffer' (default): raw framebuffer pixels, 1:1 with the Resolution metadata. 'calibrated': coordinates read directly from the returned image as displayed to you, mapped via your saved vnc_calibrate record for this client+endpoint+resolution. Errors (no probe placed) if no valid record exists.

used_full_resolution.description: Confirm that you estimated these coordinates from the full-resolution image by setting this to true. If the image was scaled, cropped, or you are unsure of the resolution, set to false and use vnc_grid to verify your coordinates.

used_grid.description: Set to true if you used vnc_grid to determine or refine these coordinates. Grid-derived coordinates are more reliable than freehand estimation from screenshots.

name: vnc_grid
description: Overlay a labeled coordinate grid on a screenshot WITHOUT clicking or interacting with the remote desktop. Divides the screen into a grid of cells labeled A1-P12 (columns A-P, rows 1-12). Returns the annotated screenshot AND a text mapping of every cell label to its center pixel coordinate. Use this to identify click targets by cell label, then click at the cell center coordinates. Much faster than multiple probe calls. The grid is drawn server-side only — no remote desktop interaction.

name: vnc_click
description: Click at a specific screen position. Supports left, right, and middle mouse buttons, and double-click. Returns both a text confirmation with coordinates AND a screenshot showing a yellow marker ring at the exact click point for visual verification. If the helper agent is running, the marker overlay is drawn on screen before the screenshot is captured. IMPORTANT: Before clicking, verify the target window is in the foreground using vnc_active_window, and confirm coordinates using vnc_probe, vnc_grid, or vnc_ocr_region. Prefer keyboard shortcuts (Alt+Tab, Tab, Enter) over clicks when possible.

coordinate_space.description: 'framebuffer' (default): raw framebuffer pixels, 1:1 with the Resolution metadata. 'calibrated': coordinates read directly from the returned image as displayed to you, mapped via your saved vnc_calibrate record for this client+endpoint+resolution. Errors (no click performed) if no valid record exists.

probe_validated.description: Confirm that you used vnc_probe to visually verify these exact coordinates before clicking. Set to true only if the probe marker was on the intended target.

coordinates_confirmed.description: Confirm that the coordinates given point to the intended click target. Set to true only after verifying via probe, grid, window position, or OCR.

name: vnc_type_text
description: Type a string of text on the remote desktop using direct keysym events. Each character is sent as its exact Unicode keysym — no shift-key workarounds needed. For special characters that may not work reliably, use vnc_paste_text instead.

name: vnc_key_press
description: Press a key or key combination (e.g., 'Return', 'ctrl+c', 'alt+F4', 'shift+a'). Key names follow X11 keysym names.

name: vnc_move_mouse
description: Move the mouse cursor to a position without clicking.

coordinate_space.description: 'framebuffer' (default): raw framebuffer pixels. 'calibrated': coordinates read directly from the returned image as displayed to you, mapped via your saved vnc_calibrate record. Errors (no move) if no valid record exists.

name: vnc_drag
description: Click and drag from one position to another. Holds the left mouse button down during the move.

coordinate_space.description: 'framebuffer' (default): raw framebuffer pixels. 'calibrated': coordinates read directly from the returned image as displayed to you, mapped via your saved vnc_calibrate record. Errors (no drag) if no valid record exists.

name: vnc_scroll
description: Scroll at position (x, y). Sends mouse wheel events via the VNC protocol. Works on any target OS without helper agent dependency.

coordinate_space.description: 'framebuffer' (default): raw framebuffer pixels. 'calibrated': coordinates read directly from the returned image as displayed to you, mapped via your saved vnc_calibrate record. Errors (no scroll performed) if no valid record exists.

amount.description: Scroll amount. Positive = scroll up (away from user), negative = scroll down (toward user). Each unit is one wheel notch. Typical range: -10 to 10.

name: vnc_clipboard_set
description: Send text to the remote clipboard via VNC ClientCutText.

text.description: Text to place on remote clipboard

name: vnc_paste_text
description: Reliable text entry: sets the remote clipboard then sends Ctrl+V. Use this for special characters, URLs, or any text that vnc_type_text might mangle.

name: vnc_list_endpoints
description: List all registered VNC endpoints with their descriptions and connection status.

name: vnc_cursor_position
description: Get the current mouse cursor position on the remote desktop. Requires the vnc-helper agent running on the target machine.

name: vnc_window_list
description: List all visible windows on the remote desktop with their titles, positions, sizes, and process IDs. Requires the vnc-helper agent.

name: vnc_active_window
description: Get information about the currently focused window on the remote desktop including title, class, position, size, and PID. Requires the vnc-helper agent.

name: vnc_set_active_window
description: Set the active/focused window by title substring, window class name, or process ID. The matched window is restored (if minimized), brought to the foreground, and given keyboard focus. Returns the activated window's details (title, class, position, size, PID). Requires the vnc-helper agent.

title.description: Window title substring to match (partial match)

class.description: Window class name to match (exact match)

pid.description: Process ID of the window to activate

name: vnc_manage_window
description: Minimize, maximize, restore, or close a window found by title, class, or PID. Requires the vnc-helper agent.

action.description: Action to perform: minimize, maximize, restore, close

title.description: Window title substring to match (partial match)

class.description: Window class name to match (exact match)

name: vnc_run_command
description: Execute a command on the remote Windows machine and return stdout, stderr, and exit code. The command is passed to cmd.exe /c. Requires the vnc-helper agent. Use this for operations that don't need GUI interaction.

name: vnc_shell
description: Execute a script on the remote Windows machine. Requires the vnc-helper agent. shell="powershell" (default) runs the script in the agent's persistent PowerShell session: state ($variables, Set-Location, imported modules) survives across calls, and PowerShell pipelines/quoting are never mangled by cmd.exe parsing. shell="cmd" routes to the stateless run_command path. Response data: output (stdout+stderr merged, in order), exit_code ($LASTEXITCODE of the last native command, sticky within the session, null only before any native command has run), elapsed_ms, timed_out (child killed; it respawns on next call), session_restarted (previous session was dead; prior state is gone). Interactive prompts fail fast (-NonInteractive).

script.description: Script text to execute. Multi-line welcome; passed verbatim to PowerShell (no shell quoting).

shell.description: "powershell" (default, persistent session) or "cmd" (stateless cmd.exe /c via run_command).

name: vnc_browser_eval
description: Evaluate JavaScript in the target machine's Firefox/Bloom browser via the agent's Marionette client (attaches to the browser the user is actually running — real profile, live tabs). context="content" (default) runs in the current tab; context="chrome" gives browser-privileged JS (Services, ChromeUtils, gBrowser). Returns data.error (Marionette error object or null) and data.value (raw WebDriver result envelope — your returned object/primitive is under value.value). Requires the browser to run with its remote agent enabled (-marionette flag or marionette.enabled, port 2828). Use this instead of coordinate clicks for web content. Known limitation: DANE cert-verify testing must use interactively launched browsers (socket-process verification does not fire under Marionette).

script.description: JavaScript to evaluate; the top-level return value is serialized back as JSON.

name: vnc_browser_navigate
description: Navigate the current tab of the target machine's Firefox/Bloom browser to a URL (the browser the user is actually running). Uses the agent's shared long-lived Marionette session, so element handles from earlier vnc_browser_find calls go stale after navigation. Returns final url/title, a session_established flag (true means the session was (re)created by this call and any prior handles are stale), and elapsed_ms. Requires the browser's remote agent (-marionette, port 2828) and WinMCP >= 0.7.0 on the target.

url.description: URL to load in the current tab.

name: vnc_browser_find
description: Find element(s) in the current page of the target's browser by CSS selector (default), XPath, id, or tag name. Returns session-scoped element handles for vnc_browser_click / vnc_browser_type / vnc_browser_text / vnc_browser_screenshot. Handles die when the page navigates, when the shared Marionette session is re-established (browser restart, >60 min idle reap, vnc_browser_reset, or a mid-command reconnect), or when the element leaves the DOM; subsequent use then errors with 'stale element reference' - re-run vnc_browser_find. Single mode errors 'no such element' when nothing matches; all=true returns an array (possibly empty, max 64) instead of erroring.

value.description: The selector (CSS expression, XPath expression, element id, or tag name).

all.description: true = find all matches (array, empty when none). Default: false (first match, error when none).

name: vnc_browser_click
description: Click an element in the target's browser by handle from vnc_browser_find. This is a trusted in-DOM click, not a coordinate click - prefer it for web content and fall back to vnc_click only for browser chrome UI that Marionette cannot see. Errors 'stale element reference' when the handle has died (navigation, session re-establish) - re-run vnc_browser_find.

name: vnc_browser_type
description: Focus an element (input, textarea, contenteditable) and type text into it, by handle from vnc_browser_find. Plain text only - no special keys (Enter, Tab, shortcuts); use vnc_browser_eval or vnc_key_press for those. Stale-handle handling as in vnc_browser_click.

text.description: Text to type into the element.

name: vnc_browser_text
description: Read an element's rendered text content by handle from vnc_browser_find. For form fields prefer vnc_browser_eval if you need the value attribute instead of rendered text. Stale-handle handling as in vnc_browser_click.

name: vnc_browser_screenshot
description: Screenshot the target browser's viewport (default) or a single element (when an element handle is given). Returns a PNG image - purely observational, no input. For full-desktop context use vnc_screenshot instead. Stale-handle handling as in vnc_browser_click.

element.description: Optional element handle from vnc_browser_find - captures just that element.

name: vnc_browser_reset
description: Tear down the agent's shared long-lived Marionette browser session (all element handles die). The next browser op transparently establishes a fresh session. Use after a wedged session, or when you intentionally need a clean WebDriver session. Does not affect vnc_browser_eval (per-call sessions).

name: vnc_browser_state
description: Diagnostics for the agent's shared Marionette browser session: alive flag, port, context, session age/idle times, command count, and current tab URL/title (best-effort probes; a dead browser makes the call tear the session down and report alive=false). The session lazily establishes on first use and is reaped after 60 minutes idle.

name: vnc_screen_info
description: Get screen information including monitor layout, resolution, and DPI from the remote desktop. Requires the vnc-helper agent.

name: vnc_upload_file
description: Upload a file from the local machine to the remote desktop. Reads the local file, base64-encodes it, and sends to the helper agent which writes it to the specified remote path. Max 10MB. Requires the vnc-helper agent.

local_path.description: Absolute path to the file on the local (FreeBSD/Linux) machine

remote_path.description: Absolute path where the file should be written on the remote (Windows) machine

name: vnc_download_file
description: Download a file from the remote desktop to the local machine. The helper agent reads the remote file, base64-encodes it, and the MCP server saves it locally. Max 10MB. Requires the vnc-helper agent.

remote_path.description: Absolute path to the file on the remote (Windows) machine

local_path.description: Absolute path where the file should be saved on the local (FreeBSD/Linux) machine

name: vnc_ocr_region
description: Recognize text in a screen region using OCR (Windows.Media.Ocr). Captures the specified rectangle from the remote desktop and returns the recognized text. Requires the vnc-helper agent on the target machine (Win10/11).

x.description: X coordinate of the top-left corner of the region

y.description: Y coordinate of the top-left corner of the region

w.description: Width of the region in pixels (max 4096)

h.description: Height of the region in pixels (max 4096)

lang.description: OCR language tag (e.g. "en-US", "es", "ja"). Default: system language.

name: vnc_clipboard_get
description: Read the last clipboard text received from the remote desktop via VNC ServerCutText. The VNC server sends clipboard updates when the user copies text on the remote machine. Returns the most recent clipboard content, or a message if no clipboard data has been received yet.

name: vnc_helper_clipboard_get
description: Read the current Windows clipboard text using the Windows API directly (CF_UNICODETEXT). Unlike vnc_clipboard_get which reads VNC protocol clipboard data, this reads the actual Windows clipboard with full Unicode support. Requires the vnc-helper agent.

name: vnc_helper_clipboard_set
description: Set the Windows clipboard text using the Windows API directly (CF_UNICODETEXT). Supports full Unicode including CJK, emoji, and special characters. More reliable than vnc_clipboard_set which uses the VNC protocol (Latin-1 only). After setting, use vnc_key_press with Ctrl+V to paste. Requires the vnc-helper agent.

text.description: Text to place on the clipboard (UTF-8, full Unicode support)

name: vnc_ui_tree
description: Get the accessibility tree of the foreground window (or a specific process). Returns a hierarchical JSON structure with element names, control types, automation IDs, positions, and sizes. Use this to understand the UI structure before interacting with elements. Much more reliable than screenshots for identifying interactive controls. Requires the vnc-helper agent.

depth.description: Maximum tree depth (1-10). Default: 3. Higher values return more detail but take longer.

pid.description: Process ID to inspect. If omitted, uses the foreground window.

name: vnc_ui_element_text
description: Get the text or value of a UI element found by name or automation ID. Works with text boxes, labels, combo boxes, and other text-bearing controls. More reliable than OCR for reading specific control values. On multiple matches and no explicit index, the response reports matches/candidates with bounding rectangles and text null — retry with index. Requires the vnc-helper agent.

name.description: Element name to search for. Exact match by default (see 'match').

automation_id.description: AutomationId to search for (exact match, more reliable than name)

control_type.description: Filter by control type: Button, Edit, Text, ComboBox, CheckBox, RadioButton, ListItem, TreeItem, MenuItem, Window, etc.

match.description: Name match mode: 'exact' (default, full string) or 'substring' (case-insensitive partial match on the Name property).

index.description: When multiple elements match: pick the index-th candidate (0-based, order from tree walk). If omitted and several match, nothing is read — the response lists matches with bounding rects for disambiguation.

name: vnc_ui_click_element
description: Find a UI element by name or automation ID and invoke its default action (click button, toggle checkbox, select item, expand dropdown). Names match exactly by default; pass match="substring" for a case-insensitive partial match. FAILS CLOSED on ambiguity: if several elements match and no index is given, nothing is activated — the response lists candidates with bounding rects; retry with index or vnc_click on a candidate rect. Requires the vnc-helper agent.

name.description: Element name to find and click (exact by default; match="substring" for partial)

automation_id.description: AutomationId to find and click (more reliable than name)

control_type.description: Filter by control type to disambiguate: Button, CheckBox, RadioButton, MenuItem, ListItem, TreeItem, etc.

match.description: Name match mode: 'exact' (default, full string) or 'substring' (case-insensitive partial match on the Name property).

index.description: When multiple elements match: click the index-th candidate (0-based). If omitted and several match, nothing is clicked — the response enumerates candidates with bounding rects.

name: vnc_registry_read
description: Read a Windows registry value. Returns the value data with its type (REG_SZ, REG_DWORD, REG_QWORD, REG_BINARY, REG_MULTI_SZ, REG_EXPAND_SZ). Requires the vnc-helper agent.

key.description: Registry key path (e.g., "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion"). Root keys: HKLM, HKCU, HKCR, HKU, HKCC.

value.description: Value name to read. If omitted, reads the (Default) value.

name: vnc_registry_write
description: Write a Windows registry value. Creates the key if it does not exist. Supports REG_SZ (default), REG_DWORD, and REG_EXPAND_SZ types. Requires the vnc-helper agent.

value.description: Value name to write. If omitted, writes the (Default) value.

type.description: Registry value type: REG_SZ (default), REG_DWORD, or REG_EXPAND_SZ.

data.description: Value data. String for REG_SZ/REG_EXPAND_SZ, integer for REG_DWORD.

name: vnc_registry_list
description: Enumerate subkeys and values under a Windows registry key. Returns subkey names and value entries (name, type, size). Requires the vnc-helper agent.

name: vnc_list_processes
description: List all running processes on the remote desktop. Returns process name, PID, parent PID, and thread count for each process. Requires the vnc-helper agent.

name: vnc_kill_process
description: Terminate a process on the remote desktop by PID or executable name. If name is provided without PID, kills the first matching process. Requires the vnc-helper agent.

name: vnc_list_services
description: List all Windows services on the remote desktop. Returns service name, display name, and current status (running, stopped, etc.). Requires the vnc-helper agent.

name: vnc_service_control
description: Start, stop, or restart a Windows service by its service name. Requires the vnc-helper agent.

name.description: Windows service name (not display name, e.g., "wuauserv" for Windows Update)

action.description: Action to perform on the service

name: vnc_calibrate
description: Measure and save the pixel transform between the coordinates you see in returned images and real framebuffer pixels. Run ONCE per (client, endpoint, resolution); the record is stored on disk and stays valid until the target resolution changes or you re-run calibration. Flow: action=start places numbered markers and returns an annotated image; report where each marker's magenta center dot appears in the image AS DISPLAYED TO YOU via action=submit (samples:[{id,x,y}]); if the fit RMSE exceeds 4px a refine round places additional markers automatically; action=commit saves the fit to disk. action=status inspects the current record, action=clear deletes it. After committing, pass coordinate_space="calibrated" on vnc_click/vnc_drag/vnc_move_mouse/vnc_scroll/vnc_probe and read target positions directly from returned images — no manual scaling or grid math needed.

id.description: Marker id as shown in the calibration image (e.g. M1)

x.description: Observed X position of the marker's magenta dot, in the coordinate system of the image as displayed to you

y.description: Observed Y position of the marker's magenta dot, in the coordinate system of the image as displayed to you
